en: Anything you wish
There's a cut on my hand
If I can't hold a brush, I'm finished.
As you wish
Strange... it's like waking from a nightmare.
No, more like I'm still inside it
My body feels so heavy
You. Would you mind not standing there?
You're ruining my composition. Further right... yes.
My apologies. Do you dabble in painting?
Dabble? It's nothing so frivolous.
Painting is my self-expression and my soul.
Anyway, why are you in my studio?
Are you a thief? Or a pushy peddler?
What a thing to say.
Leaving a door onto the street wide open,
do you not think it is you who is careless?
Excuse me? What kind of talk is that?
Ugh, now I can't concentrate on my painting!
Kindly get out!
You again?
What is it this time?
Forgive my rudeness the other day.
I wished to see your work.
Hmm. Who'd have thought you liked art.
Oh well, why not look around the studio?
But try anything funny and I'll call the police.
When you've seen them, just go quietly. You're in the way.
Oh...? What do you want?
You know I want nothing to do
with the likes of you, right? Now, go home.
If you like, tell me what you think of my paintings.
Well, back again? You never learn.
Maybe you really do like art.
Look around, just don't get in my way.
If you like, tell me what you think.
A painting no one sees might as well be dead.
It must be seen and stir something in people.
Well? Do you like my paintings?
Are they hard to understand?
Tell me if there's one you like.
Oh... it's you. Come in.
You made me angry at first, but I'm used to you now.
As long as you don't disturb my painting,
feel free to come and go.
Whether my paintings sell or not
isn't the point. Once in my life, I want to
note: Words of #8127 moved here so the box fits 3 lines (rows #8125-#8127 used only in msg 316384).

en: paint a picture that stays in someone's heart.
That's why I paint.
Oh? ...Who are you?
I don't know you.
I've no business with strangers. No salesmen.
Goodbye.
I'll call the police. Go home.
What, back again?
If it's paintings, I'm not selling.
And don't come at such an ungodly hour.
Back again? Want to see my paintings?
Then I'll have them ready next time, by day,
so come in through the studio door.
You came. All right, I'll hear you out.
I don't know what you do for a living,
but I can tell you're quite the eccentric.
But I suppose I'm the same. Hee hee hee.
Come see my paintings, as long as you don't disturb me.
I won't drive you away anymore. I'm sorry.
Now, let us see if this woman is of any use
note: Stern player thought; #152 '...' follows, then a pause and #8147 on a new line.

en: She can do her best as my servant, then.
No

en: A little more... just a little more...
Oh, excuse me. Do you paint?
Yes. Painting is my self-expression and my soul.
N-no, that's not it at all.

en: I apologize for coming in uninvited.
note: Gentle branch (msg 316635), followed by a pause and #8154 on a new line.

en: But leaving a door onto the main street open,
weren't you a little careless too?
I'm sorry about the other day.
I'd like to see the works in your studio
Oh well, why not have a look?
You made me angry at first, but I'm used to you now.
